outcome: S-nitrosylation levels of catalase, peroxiredoxin, ERK1/2, AKT, caspase-3, and caspase-9 in placental tissue
cohort: Placental tissue from 8 women with gestational diabetes mellitus and 8 women with healthy pregnancies
finding: S-nitrosylation of catalase, peroxiredoxin, ERK1/2 and AKT were increased in GDM placentas, while caspase-9 nitrosylation was decreased, suggesting that altered S-nitrosylation may contribute to placental dysfunction in GDM.
